description: Look up a best-effort contact email for a single business website (checks the homepage and common contact pages). Use this for one specific website, e.g. from a saved list or CSV, rather than re-running search_leads. May return a null email if none could be found; this tool never fabricates an address.

website.description: The business website URL to look up a contact email for, e.g. "https://example.com".

name: find_email
